questions.q: In repertorisation, the 'totality of symptoms' is best understood as:
opts: the characteristic symptoms forming a complete picture of the patient
questions.why: Topic 4, Repertory. Weighted characteristic symptoms, not a mere count.

questions.q: A burst abdomen after surgery in a debilitated patient is called:
questions.why: Topic 9, Surgery, ENT, Eye and First Aid. Due to poor healing.

questions.q: In measles, the rash typically appears on about the:
opts: 1st day of fever, on the trunk
2nd day of fever, on the palms and soles
4th day of fever, starting behind the ears and along the hairline
7th day of fever, on the abdomen
questions.why: The maculopapular measles rash appears around day 4, starting behind the ears and at the hairline, then spreading downwards.

questions.q: A thin, breathless COPD patient with pursed-lip breathing, a hyperinflated chest and near-normal blood gases until late is described as a:
questions.why: Emphysema-dominant patients hyperventilate to keep oxygenation ('pink puffers'); bronchitis-dominant patients are hypoxic, cyanosed and oedematous ('blue bloaters').

questions.q: Low serum T4 with a high TSH indicates:
questions.why: A failing thyroid removes negative feedback, so the pituitary raises TSH; in pituitary failure both T4 and TSH are low.

questions.q: Under the law, a doctor's professional records should generally be preserved for at least:
questions.why: Topic 10, Community and Forensic Medicine, Ethics. As per the medical ethics regulations.
Topic 1, Organon and Philosophy. Itching is the hallmark of psora.

questions.q: The erythrocyte sedimentation rate (ESR) is typically very high in:
questions.why: Topic 6, Pathology, Microbiology and Diagnostics. ESR rises with raised globulins and fibrinogen; it falls in polycythaemia and sickle cell disease.

questions.q: Mental and physical exhaustion from grief, loss of fluids or long illness, with indifference and craving for fruit and juicy things, suggests:
questions.why: Topic 2, Materia Medica. Phos acid: apathy after grief, chronic weakness.

questions.q: The method of repertorisation that starts with a characteristic keynote and studies only the remedies under it is:
questions.why: Topic 4, Repertory. Quick but risky if the keynote is not truly characteristic.
